sparsha.meaning: Sparsha: umbral/partial contact begins. Vedh/sutak is counted from this. No snana or fresh food yet.

moksha.meaning: Moksha: umbral/partial release. After this, bathe and take fresh food (grastasta may delay food further).

sutak.meaning: Standard sutak: from N prahars before sparsha until moksha.
sutak.end_scope: Sutak end is moksha: snana/homa and food resume after moksha.

relaxed_sutak.meaning: Relaxed sutak (children, elderly, sick): from 1 prahar before sparsha until moksha.

ritual_boundary.scriptural_instructions: Ordinary visible eclipse: solar vedha 4 prahars before sparsha prahar; lunar vedha 3 prahars (4 if grastodaya). Children/elderly/sick: 1 prahar.

punya_kaal.note: Punya kaal lasts while the eclipse is locally visible.

post_eclipse_ritual.ritual_completion_requirement: After eclipse release, bathe and take fresh food.
